description: Bonus cleanups bundled with the phase-3 PR: (a) delete the orphaned client/src/pages/tools/Stories.tsx (715 lines, 37 KB, no remaining references — App.tsx and prefetch.ts only reference SocialStories.tsx; the /stories route redirects to /reading which uses StoriesContent), (b) make StreamedOutput screen-reader-friendly by emitting aria-live updates only on word/sentence boundaries instead of every chunk.
steps: Search all of client/src for imports of pages/tools/Stories — confirm zero references.
Rewrite client/src/components/StreamedOutput.tsx to maintain a separate aria-live span that updates only when a chunk crosses a sentence boundary or accumulates 8+ new words.
Mark the visible streaming div aria-hidden during streaming so it isn't double-announced; remove aria-hidden when streaming completes.
acceptance_criteria: Stories.tsx no longer exists in the repo.
App still builds (no broken import paths).
Streaming output still appears smoothly to sighted users.
Screen readers announce sentence-sized chunks rather than every character.
verification: Manual screen-reader test on the Generate flow.
findings: Verified zero references to Stories.tsx (App.tsx only mentions SocialStories.tsx, and the /stories route redirects to /reading). StreamedOutput rewrite preserves the existing visual behaviour and prop surface.
